# CodeHS

> CodeHS is a comprehensive K-12 computer science education platform offering standards-aligned curriculum, certifications, and teacher tools across multiple programming languages and skill levels.

CodeHS provides schools and districts with a complete CS solution including 100+ customizable courses, an interactive web-based IDE, professional development, and data analytics. The platform supports AP-endorsed curricula, cybersecurity training, and differentiated learning through AI-powered tools.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- Java
- AP Computer Science
- Web Design
- Cybersecurity
- CodeHS Pro
- AI Creator
- Cyber Range
- Online IDE
- LMS Integration
- Classroom Management
- Student Progress Tracking
- Computer Science Certifications
- Standards-Aligned Curriculum

## Core Platform & Products

- [CodeHS - Teach Coding and Computer Science at Your School](https://codehs.com): CodeHS homepage: K-12 coding platform with Python, JavaScript, and computer science curriculum.
- [Web-Based IDE for Education](https://codehs.com/ide): Free browser-based IDE supporting 10+ languages with real-time collaboration for classrooms.
- [CodeHS Pro](https://codehs.com/pro): CodeHS Pro premium features: grading tools, AI hints, classroom integration, and analytics.
- [CodeHS AI Creator](https://codehs.com/ai_creator): AI-powered tool for generating differentiated coding assignments aligned to standards.
- [Cyber Range](https://codehs.com/cyber_range): Interactive cybersecurity labs with CTF challenges aligned to AP Cybersecurity standards.

## Curriculum & Courses

- [Curriculum](https://codehs.com/curriculum): 100+ customizable K-12 CS courses from elementary to AP CSA, Principles, and cybersecurity.
- [Course Catalog](https://codehs.com/curriculum/catalog): Searchable catalog of AP and programming language courses for middle and high school.
- [Elementary Curriculum (CodeHop)](https://codehs.com/codehop): CodeHop: Elementary computer science curriculum using Scratch and ScratchJr for K-5 students.
- [Certifications](https://codehs.com/info/certifications): Industry-based CS certifications in Java, Python, JavaScript, and Web Design for K-12.
- [Spanish Curriculum](https://codehs.com/curriculum/spanish): Spanish-language CS curriculum for English language learners covering AP and programming.
- [Hour of Code](https://codehs.com/hourofcode): Hour of Code activities with Karel, Tracy, and block-based coding for beginners.
- [Typing Curriculum](https://codehs.com/keyboarding): Standards-aligned typing curriculum with gamified learning and real-time progress tracking.

## For Schools & Districts

- [Districts - K-12 Computer Science Curriculum](https://codehs.com/districts): District-wide CS implementation with curriculum, PD, data insights, and dedicated support.
- [Schools](https://codehs.com/schools): School program offering AP-endorsed curriculum, certifications, and teacher professional development.
- [Teacher Use Cases](https://codehs.com/teachers): Teacher-focused platform features for AP CSA, classroom management, and course authoring.

## Classroom Management & Teacher Tools

- [Classroom Management](https://codehs.com/info/platform/classroom_management): Features for managing student rosters, assignments, communication, and virtual teaching.
- [Assignments](https://codehs.com/info/platform/assignments): Guide to creating and customizing CS assignments with due dates and LMS integration.
- [Grading](https://codehs.com/info/grading): Grading tools including autograder, Fast Grade, and CodeHS Pro feedback features.
- [Progress Tracking](https://codehs.com/info/platform/progress_tracking): Student data analytics, dashboards, and assignment monitoring for teachers and administrators.
- [Educational Platform Integrations for Districts](https://codehs.com/info/integrations): LMS integrations with Google Classroom, Clever, ClassLink for roster and grade management.
